statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)

The service was to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was to assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease
The diagnosis code R00.2 applies to this patient
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50
